title: 周一综合征
caption: lazy late-night lounge jazz song, soft female Mandarin vocal singing from the first bars, short 4 second intro, brushed drums, upright bass, warm electric piano, smoky small bar, relaxed, intimate, clear vocals
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
闹钟响了第三遍
我和被子谈条件
地铁挤成沙丁鱼
工位还是老地点

[Chorus]
周一综合征
没有药能治
只好等到下班
来这喝一杯
周一综合征
谁都有一点
老板他也一样
只是不承认

[Outro]
再来一杯
明天再说
